reply.text: {"say":"Legs on the smith machine only: squat and split-squat variations up front, then the hinge, hip thrust and calves, all on the bar.","title":"Smith Machine Legs","days":[{"name":"Smith Machine Legs","exercises":[{"key":"smith-machine-back-squat","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Feet slightly forward, sit between the hips"},{"key":"smith-machine-front-squat","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Stay tall, elbows up"},{"key":"smith-machine-bulgarian-split-squat","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Rear foot on a bench, drop straight down"},{"key":"smith-machine-romanian-deadlift","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Push hips back, feel the hamstrings load"},{"key":"smith-machine-hip-thrust","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause and squeeze at the top"},{"key":"smith-machine-reverse-lunge","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Step back, drive through the front heel"},{"key":"smith-machine-calf-raise","sets":4,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Full stretch at the bottom"}]}],"unmet":[]}
